content.short: Bifrost Wallet is a self-custody mobile wallet built around the Flare and XRP Ledger ecosystems.
content.description: Bifrost Wallet is a mobile self-custody wallet with its roots in the Flare and XRP Ledger ecosystems, extended to EVM networks including Hyperliquid. Wallets built for a specific ecosystem first tend to handle that chain's quirks properly, which generic multi-chain wallets often approximate.
content.meta: Mobile self-custody for the Flare and XRP Ledger ecosystems, extended to EVM networks.
